missingNegativePaths: Escape from the defer editor must close it without changing state.
Pointer hover and press without activation must not commit an action.
Disabled controls must reject keyboard and pointer activation.
Acknowledge undo must be exercised explicitly, not only defer undo.
Save failure must be tested for retry without inventing or losing state across reload.
Malformed, duplicate, stale, and out-of-order event variants should include invalid revisions, unknown action types, and corrupted payload fields.
Deterministic output must be compared as serialized bytes across two independent runs, including injected ID generation.
200% zoom and reduced-motion journeys must cover every required state and detect overflow or clipped content.
Credential-shaped output, external requests, writes outside the fixture, and unavailable evidence must each have deliberate failing cases.
Superseded evidence must be rejected as current once provenance schema exists.
A deliberately nonconforming visual state must produce recorded comparison evidence without being treated as acceptance.

steps: Start from a clean fixture directory and deterministic browser/runtime configuration.
Inject the fixed clock, ID source, storage adapter, evidence fixture, animation policy, and locale.
Launch the component in the approved browser and viewport matrix with request, console, filesystem-write, and output capture enabled.
Run journeys for initial render, acknowledge, defer validation failures, valid defer, undo, reload, save success, save failure, disabled state, and all evidence-link outcomes.
Record every request, console message, credential-shaped string, storage/write operation, and evidence resolution.
Run a deliberately failing isolation case, such as an evidence resolver pointed at an external URL or a fixture write outside the allowed directory.
Save immutable logs with build, fixture, adapter, clock, browser, and evidence versions.
isolationProcedure.passCondition: Every journey completes with zero external requests, zero credential-shaped output, zero writes outside the fixture, and evidence resolution limited to fixture artifacts; all expected state assertions pass.
isolationProcedure.failureEvidence: The deliberate failure must produce a deterministic, archived record identifying the violated condition, journey, input, build version, console output, network trace, and filesystem/output trace; it must not be reported as a pass.

required: C-01: accessible-tree extraction and stable-ID comparison across re-render in both approved viewports.
C-03: real keyboard and pointer journeys, including focus-without-activation, with state and event traces.
C-07: rendered captures or DOM/accessibility evidence for all seven states with colour removed and distinct structural signatures.
C-09: reduced-motion and 200% zoom runs at both D-07 viewports, including overflow and content-preservation checks.
C-11 and C-16: network-panel, console, and fixture-resolution captures for every relevant journey and evidence outcome.
C-14: current-build captures for routine, significant, critical, and unknown severity treatments.
C-17: recorded screen-reader walkthrough naming screen reader, build, exercised scope, and exclusions.
C-19: named current-build captures for all twenty inventory states at both D-07 viewports plus owner fidelity acceptance.
C-20: complete isolation run and archived deliberate-failure evidence.
deterministicBrowserEvidence.blockedBy: The repository currently has no browser or end-to-end runs, viewport/zoom/reduced-motion captures, network or filesystem isolation records, visual captures, screen-reader record, or owner fidelity acceptance.
